ios.head: App Total Revenue -38.4% — down in line with the new subs signed up 7 days earlier (-54.0%).

ios.head: Where installs come from is shifting away from Organic Install (-45.3% vs -16.7% for installs overall).
ios.body: Organic Install (YMK · US) was 1,245, -45.3% against the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks, while total installs moved -16.7% — a difference of -28.6 percentage points. Organic Install is now 27.1% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving away from it; free traffic slipping while paid holds up means we are buying more of the same installs..

ios.head: App Total New User is moving faster than the other steps (+0.8% vs about -16.7%).
ios.body: App Total New User is +0.8% while the other steps are all moving about -16.7% — a gap of +17.5pp. When one step moves very differently from the rest, the cause is usually specific to that step.

ios.head: No big App Total Revenue swing expected in about 7 days — the share of installs that become subs is normal.
ios.body: App Total New Subs is -18.9% and App Total Install is -16.7%; the gap between them (-2.2pp) is under the 10pp we treat as a real signal, so the share of people who install and then subscribe is close to normal. New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So nothing unusual is building up that would swing App Total Revenue in about 7 days.

insights.title: Install source — App Total Install -14.2% — Organic Install is behind most of it (-2,464, -17.9%).

Where that came from: Organic Install -2,464 (-17.9%), Paid Install -891 (-7.1%), SEO Install -617 (-34.2%). Organic Install moved the most on its own (-2,464, -17.9%) and is now 46.1% of all installs, so that is the channel to look at first. Known event: YCP iOS was delisted from the App Store on 2026-10-21 (因下架); its iOS Install / New User collapse is expected and its Install→New Subs conversion is an artefact. insights.body: In GB, 18.8% of installs turn into new subs, versus 13.1% across all markets and apps (+5.8pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 4% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -24.9% this period.

insights.body: In FR, 12.0% of installs now turn into new subs — +32.5% versus last period. It is about 2% of revenue (a market worth watching): more of the people downloading are subscribing, which should help revenue within a week or two.
